headline: Hormuz: The Artery of Global Oil Closes Again – Why the New Escalation Could Cause a Second Energy Shock
summary: Reports say the Strait of Hormuz, a key route for global oil, has closed again. The article warns that the new escalation could trigger a second energy shock.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of the world's seaborne oil, so disruptions there quickly affect crude prices and global energy supply.
why_moved: The article says the route has closed again and that the new escalation could cause a second energy shock, which investors price as a supply risk.
